title: 28th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/28/2024).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 22/2024 to 24/2024).

Question time: Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir asks Minister of Sports, Fitness and Recreation Abdulla Rafiu when floodlights (approved under the previous government) will be installed at the B. Kendhoo football ground, and when a futsal pitch and handball court will be built.
From the Speaker's desk: the matter of removing Prosecutor General Hussain Shameem from office is sent to the relevant standing committee under Rule 232(b) of the Majlis Standing Orders.
First reading of the Urban Development Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Vilingili MP Azim Abdul Azeez.
Preliminary debate on the Foreign Investment Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hithadhoo Central MP Ahmed Azaan Marzooq.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Business Registration Act (Law No. 18/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Faresmaathodaa MP Ashraf Rasheed.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Maldives Securities Act (Law No. 2/2006), submitted on behalf of the government by Kendhikulhudhoo MP Mohamed Afoo Hamid.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took a question on Kendhoo sports facilities, sent the Prosecutor General's removal to committee, introduced the Urban Development Bill and debated foreign investment, business registration and securities bills.
